title: Nell | Boho maxi dress with artisan embroidery in blue
bodyHtml:
This flowing maxi dress captures effortless elegance with hand-detailed embroidered florals that feel both romantic and timeless. The relaxed silhouette drapes beautifully, moving with you on warm days and cooler evenings alike. It's the kind of piece that works from seaside strolls to garden gatherings—a versatile wardrobe staple that lets you feel completely yourself.

Why you'll love it

  • Gorgeous hand-worked floral embroidery with genuine artisan appeal
  • Relaxed, flowing shape that skims without clinging
  • Breathable and light—brilliant for the Australian climate
  • Effortlessly pairs with simple jewellery or a lightweight scarf
  • Works equally well dressed up or down, day or evening
  • The kind of timeless piece you'll reach for season after season
  • Beautifully made detail that sets it apart from the everyday
